title: SKALOS: Learning to Distinguish Similar Skills with Capability Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.34728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skills provide LLM agents with reusable procedural knowledge, making appropriate skill selection essential for reliable agent behavior. As skill libraries expand, distinguishing semantically similar candidates becomes increasingly difficult. Existing methods encode or rewrite skill descriptions for relevance-based ranking, yet heterogeneous descriptions can obscure capability differences. To address this challenge, we propose SKALOS, a graph-native reranker that compares skills via explicit capability evidence. Its multi-hierarchy graph aligns equivalent expressions across skills while preserving skill-specific capability evidence. Since individually relevant capability elements may not jointly support a query, semiring-based capability witness learning scores each branch by its weakest evidence, checks joint support for the extracted requirements within one implementation, and selects the strongest alternative. translated_title: SKALOS：利用能力图学习区分相似技能
translated_abstract: 技能为大语言模型（LLM）智能体提供可复用的程序性知识，因此恰当的技能选择对于智能体的可靠行为至关重要。随着技能库规模的扩大，区分语义相似的候选技能变得越来越困难。现有方法通过编码或重写技能描述来进行基于相关性的排序，然而异构的描述可能会掩盖技能间的能力差异。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SKALOS，一种通过显式能力证据来比较技能的图原生重排序器。其多层级图结构能够在对齐技能间等价表达的同时，保留特定技能的能力证据。由于单独相关的能力要素可能无法共同支持某个查询，基于半环的能力见证学习通过最弱证据对每个分支进行评分，在单一实现中检查对所提取需求的联合支持，并选择最强的备选方案。为减少……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SKALOS提出了一种图原生的技能重排序方法，通过多层级能力图和基于半环的能力见证学习，利用显式能力证据来区分语义相似的技能，从而提升LLM智能体技能选择的可靠性。
en_tdlr: SKALOS is a graph-native reranker that distinguishes semantically similar skills by comparing explicit capability evidence through multi-hierarchy capability graphs and semiring-based capability witness learning, thereby improving reliable skill selection for LLM agents.
